_comment: Station, camera model and objects for the HUD. Heights are metres above sea level (top of object). Edit freely; the page reloads it every 5 min.

station._pos_note: antenna position from user (Google Maps) 2026-10-11; ground 117.7 m (GUGiK NMT); antenna 15 m above ground (user) -> h = 132.7 m ASL

camera._comment: hfov: rectilinear-equivalent at image centre (measured 34.6 px/deg @2560). pitch: camera tilt, deg (+up). az_offset: true az of image centre = rotator az + az_offset. az_delay: video lags rotctld by this (s).
camera._lens_note: 2026-10-11 night: lens distortion fitted from 4700 SIFT matches between frames at rotator 97..142 deg (tools/calib/distortion.py, NPP=2: optical centre free, rms 0.049 deg; rectilinear model was 0.59 deg and put objects 3.4 deg too far out at 30 deg off-centre). Roll fitted +1.26.
camera._pitch_note: 2026-10-17 after the mast remount: Sky Tower top and the CZK tower top both within 0.013 deg in elevation (rotator 126 before CW7); EC chimney top +0.18. History: -1.308 (2026-10-13, Sky Tower + EC chimney), -1.28 (2026-10-11).
camera._az_offset_note: 2026-10-17 13:05 UTC after the mast remount: the whole mast had turned (camera 4.5 deg left of the rotator reading). Rotator recalibrated in the SQ6EMM firmware 1.8 with CW7,122.2 at Sky Tower and the CZK tower (both 0.77 deg left of their markers with the provisional model). Earlier: CW7,122.4 (2026-10-15), K3NG \A122 (2026-10-11).

tilt._note: 2026-10-17 after the mast remount: lean now 0.54 deg (objects highest toward az 72); measured from two full turns (13 frames each) SIFT-matched to the 2026-10-12 panorama (elevation change fits a sine with rms 0.08 deg), checked against LiDAR roof edges (61 sectors, residual within +-0.4) and Sky Tower / CZK / EC chimney. Before: A 1.299 B 4.065 (4.3 deg lean). ?notilt disables.

camera._roll_note: 2026-10-17: camera levelled on the roof by the user with a live guide; roll from vertical building edges +0.02..+0.24 (right side up). Before the remount the 4.3 deg mast lean rolled the picture by up to +-4 deg with azimuth (not modelled); the remaining lean (0.5 deg) gives at most +-0.5 deg.

objects.name: Sky Tower
objects.src: building top 212 m above ground + ground 120.5 m (GUGiK NMT); OSM way 165880544. The red light first taken for Sky Tower (2026-10-11) belongs to the CZK tower just right of it (user, 2026-10-13)

objects.name: CZK Wrocław tower
objects.src: Centrum Zarządzania Kryzysowego tower (user, 2026-10-13): position from the user, red lights on top and in the middle. Top measured by the camera 2026-10-13 (el 1.99 at 2.25 km; thin mast, not in the LiDAR surface model), ground 120.7 m -> ~90 m tall

objects.name: P4 mast Majakowskiego
objects.src: rooftop base-station mast (user's position, 2026-10-12/13), UKE: P4 sp. z o.o. 'Majakowskiego 30-40' (registered ~65 m away, coordinates rounded). Top 141.3 m ASL = LiDAR NMPT 2024 peak 4 m from the point (roof ~136); camera 2026-10-13 at rotator 73: el 1.32 -> 142.0

objects.name: T-Mobile mast Metalowców
objects.src: base-station mast (user's position, 2026-10-13), UKE: T-Mobile Polska 'Metalowców 25', IdStacji 46038 (registered 13 m away). Not in the LiDAR surface model (thin); top 154.3 m ASL measured by the camera 2026-10-13 at rotator 57 (el 1.25 at 983 m), ground 118.5 -> ~36 m tall

objects.name: Ślęża RTCN
objects.src: OSM node 794745107 (136 m tower near 718 m summit)

objects.name: EC Wrocław chimney
objects.src: PGE EC Wrocław, the tall chimney (the lower one next to it carries the steam plume): position from the user, top 296.5 m ASL = LiDAR surface model peak (GUGiK NMPT 2024, sheet M-33-35-C-a-3-1), ground 116 m -> ~180 m tall (OSM way 301417638 says 186). 2026-10-13 09 UTC: top seen at el 1.60 with the tilt model = geometric 1.60.

objects.name: GSM mast Alba
objects.src: user, Google Maps 2026-10-11 (= OSM node 6142939720); ground 116.7 m (GUGiK NMT); top measured by camera: 153.1 m ASL (~36 m above ground)

_beacons_note: 23 cm beacons come from /telemetry/beacons (IARU list, merged daily by the telemetry service; dropped only when QRT or unreported > 90 days)
_summits_note: SOTA summits come from /telemetry/summits (computed by the telemetry service from the station location; SOTA_ASSOCIATIONS / SUMMIT_MAX_KM in .env)

display._comment: title: browser tab title after the call sign; layers.<name>: "on" (shown) | "off" (button, hidden at start) | "disabled" (no button, data not loaded). video_lag_s: camera->browser latency (aircraft/satellite positions are shown for that moment); geoid_n_m: geoid height above WGS84 at the station (ADS-B GPS altitude is ellipsoidal); adsb_max_km: farther aircraft are hidden (?adsbkm= overrides)
